produces: captured answers; the register itself belongs to the record-book project

questions.ask: For an attested but unnamed person, do you want the row kept, or folded into a count?
questions.why: The record-book already keeps the row. This confirms that is what you want rather than assuming it.

questions.ask: Does any of this touch your own family record?
questions.why: It changes who may write the entry and whether consent language applies. Never inferred.

refuses: Linking an entry to a living family without an explicit answer to Q2
